svg.aria-label: Caesar shift with key 3: each letter moves 3 places later, X Y Z wrap to A B C; 'I love C++ <3' becomes 'L oryh F++ <3', spaces and symbols unchanged.
svg.text: With key K = 3, every letter moves 3 places later in the alphabet
Lowercase letters move the same way: a → d, x → a
Example: “I love C++ <3” becomes “L oryh F++ <3”
To encrypt, move each letter K places forward. To decrypt, move it K places back.
